params.message:
npm advisories back under the ceiling: 8 to 6

source-map-js 1.2.1 got a high advisory (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q), which put
the audit at 8 against a ceiling of 7 and turned the advisory job red on
every pull request. 1.2.2 fixes it. http-cache-semantics, until now
without a fixed release, has one in 4.3.0 (GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp).

Both are lock-file bumps of a transitive dependency, nothing else in the
tree moves. The ceiling goes down to 6 so neither can come back.
